title.en: What an extrapolation can learn through a map

statement.zh: 经映射的未来相同的配置给每个外推同样的前段。被列表所持的世界中，某个外推在每个配置上于特征停息，恰当这样的配置其特征从某步起一致；律使每个配置不变时，恰当特征经映射之归并同去。
statement.en: Configurations with one future through the map give every extrapolation the same prefix. In a listed world, some extrapolation rests on a feature everywhere exactly where such configurations have features eventually agreeing; under a still law, exactly where the feature respects the lumping.

laws.zh: 外推从经映射之历程的前段提出特征之值：由配置出发之轨道经映射的历程（course）；从第 T 步起每步提出特征之值即从 T 起停息（RestsFrom），某个 T 存在即停息（Rests）。
laws.en: An extrapolation proposes a value of the feature from the prefix of a course through the map: the course through the map of a configuration's orbit (course); proposing the feature's value at every step from T on is resting from T (RestsFrom), and resting is resting from some T (Rests).

laws.zh: 经映射的未来相同的两个配置给每个外推每一步同样的前段；所以在其特征不同之步，所提出的值至多在一处对，不用判定；特征之值可判定时，所提出的值在一处不合，而两处前段处处相同。
laws.en: Two configurations with the same future through the map give every extrapolation the same prefix at every step; so at a step where their features differ a proposed value is right on at most one, with no decision, and with the feature's values decided a proposed value misses on one while the two prefixes stay equal at every step.

laws.zh: 在两处都停息的外推，其特征从某步起一致；所以特征在任意晚处不同时，没有外推在两处都停息；律使两个配置不变、映射不分开它们而特征不同时即如此。
laws.en: An extrapolation resting on both has features agreeing from some step on; so where they differ at arbitrarily late steps no extrapolation rests on both, already where the law leaves both configurations unchanged, the map does not tell them apart and their features differ.

laws.zh: 特征从映射读出时，经映射之值上的套索候选的外推，其所提出的值经读出，在被列表所持的世界中从辨识的界起停息；它不被给予配置、其数目或特征的任何值。
laws.en: Where the feature is read off the map, the extrapolation over the lasso candidates on the values through the map, its proposals read off, rests on the feature in every world a list holds from the identification bound on; it is given neither the configurations, nor how many there are, nor any value of the feature.

laws.zh: 恰当地：在被列表所持的世界中，某个经映射而读的外推在每个配置上停息，恰当经映射的未来相同的配置其特征从某步起一致；必要一侧对每个外推成立，充分一侧的外推依律、映射、特征与列表所建。
laws.en: Exactly: in a world a list holds, some extrapolation reading through the map rests at every configuration exactly where configurations with the same future through the map have features agreeing from some step on; the necessary side holds of every extrapolation, and the extrapolation of the sufficient side is built from the law, the map, the feature and the list.

laws.zh: 经映射之归并同去的特征总可学；律使每个配置不变时，可学的恰是经映射之归并同去者。
laws.en: Features going alike across the map's lumping are learnable; under a law leaving every configuration unchanged, exactly those are.

laws.zh: 两个坐标、律不变：映射取第一个坐标时，没有外推在 (true, false) 与 (true, true) 两处都在第二个坐标上停息，第二个坐标不经第一个同去；映射取两个坐标时，套索外推从第 2 步起停息。
laws.en: Two coordinates under a still law: with the map taking the first, no extrapolation rests on the second at both (true, false) and (true, true), the second not going alike across the first; with the map taking both, the lasso extrapolation rests from step 2.

laws.zh: 沿运行：确定之律的运行给外推从其起点出发之轨道的前段，所以外推恰在停息于那条轨道处停息于这个运行；在这个映射的框架中起点相似的运行给每个外推相同的前段；在列表持有的世界中，特征恰在起点相似之运行的特征从某步起一致处沿每个运行可学，在不变之律下恰在特征经映射之归并同去处可学。
laws.en: Along runs: a determined law's run gives an extrapolation its orbit's prefix, so the extrapolation rests on the run exactly where it rests on that orbit; runs beginning alike in the map's frame give every extrapolation one prefix; where a list holds the world, a feature is learnable along every run exactly where such runs have features agreeing from some step on, under a still law where it goes alike across the map's lumping.

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。经映射之值的可判定相等（DecidableEq R）只作为套索外推与 fromLaw 的条件，在 predicts_through 的陈述与 learnable_iff 的证明中；特征之值的可判定相等（DecidableEq V）只在 missed_on_one。
hypotheses.en: No axiom. Decidable equality of the values through the map (DecidableEq R) appears only as a condition of the lasso extrapolation and of fromLaw, in the statement of predicts_through and the proof of learnable_iff; decidable equality of feature values (DecidableEq V) only in missed_on_one.

hypotheses.zh: 每条定理的条件写在其中：经映射的未来相同；特征在任意晚处不同；轨道或世界被列表所持；特征从映射读出（val s = g (reg s)）；律使配置不变。
hypotheses.en: Each theorem's conditions are written into it: the same future through the map; features differing at arbitrarily late steps; the orbit or the world held by a list; the feature read off the map (val s = g (reg s)); the law leaving configurations unchanged.

hypotheses.zh: learnable_iff 及其推论中配置在 Type 中（Identification.firstFit 的类型）；其余定理对任意宇宙成立。
hypotheses.en: In learnable_iff and its corollaries the configurations live in Type (the type of Identification.firstFit); the other theorems hold in every universe.

does_not_show.zh: 充分一侧的外推依律、映射、特征与列表所建；不被给予什么的外推只对从映射现在之值读出的特征证明。
does_not_show.en: The extrapolation of the sufficient side is built from the law, the map, the feature and the list; an extrapolation given nothing is shown only for features read off the map's present value.

does_not_show.zh: 一般的律下，可学不推出经映射之归并同去：读出映射下一值的特征可学而不必同去。
does_not_show.en: Under a general law, learnable does not imply going alike across the map's lumping: a feature reading the map's next value is learnable without it.

does_not_show.zh: 条件关于成对的配置，不是逐配置的；读出它需要知道世界。
does_not_show.en: The condition is on pairs of configurations, not on each; reading it off needs the world.

does_not_show.zh: 外推仍须分辨经映射的值；经映射的值本身不被分辨时的学习没有陈述。
does_not_show.en: The extrapolation still tells the values through the map apart; learning where those values themselves are not told apart is not stated.

does_not_show.zh: 与人的学习、神经网络、注意或感知阈限的对应不由此检查。
does_not_show.en: No correspondence to human learning, neural networks, attention or perceptual thresholds is checked.

detail.zh: Pair：映射取第一个坐标时，没有外推在 (true, false) 与 (true, true) 两处都在第二个坐标上停息（Pair.first_not_predicts）。
detail.en: Pair: with the map taking the first coordinate, no extrapolation rests on the second at both (true, false) and (true, true) (Pair.first_not_predicts).

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261014T091930.724493Z）：Becoming.Learnable 的 23 项声明（17 项定理）公理报告为空；检查器并核对核心纯净。作者反审见研究；未经独立审查。

next_delta.zh: 不被给予什么、对每个可学特征停息的外推，或其不存在的见证；不确定过程上与概率读法下的可学性；实际的映射（阈值、注意）的实例。
next_delta.en: An extrapolation given nothing that rests on every learnable feature, or a witness that none does; learnability over undetermined processes and on a probabilistic reading; instances for actual maps (thresholds, attention).

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-12：“please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”。逐除外推的结果（当时称按否证学习）留下：映射不分辨值时的学习没有陈述。本结果陈述它：经映射，外推所能学的，恰是经映射的未来相同者从某步起一致之处。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用）：映射为所学划界；依 Ren 的读法，理是对结构与变化之规律的建模，这一建模经映射被学到，正如它经耦合入者被检验；阈下的差别（只经阈耦合入的条件只传递是否满足所需）只在它在经映射的未来中显现、或从特征中消失之处可学；映射之外者只经扩大映射到达：新的经水平的耦合、他者的耦合。
correspondence.en: Ren, 12 October 2026: “please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”. Extrapolation by elimination (then called learning by refutation) left learning where the map does not tell values apart unstated. This result states it: what an extrapolation can learn through a map is exactly where configurations with the same future through the map agree from some step on. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): the map bounds what is learned; on Ren's reading 理 is the modeling of the laws of structure and of change, and that modeling is learned through the map as it is tested through what couples in; a difference below threshold (a condition coupled in by threshold only passes only whether it meets the need) is learnable only where it shows in the future through the map or vanishes from the feature; what lies beyond the map is reached only by widening it: new coupling by level, another's couplings.

detail.zh: 复用 prefixOf、prefix_congr、prefix_length、Misses、Lumped、byElimination、lassos 与 tri：外推、前段、不合与归并。
detail.en: Reuses prefixOf, prefix_congr, prefix_length, Misses, Lumped, byElimination, lassos and tri: the extrapolation, the prefix, missing and lumping.

output.zh: 外推与经映射之历程的前段；逐除外推；归并。
output.en: Extrapolations and prefixes of courses through a map; extrapolation by elimination; lumping.

input.zh: 经映射而读的外推在特征上停息。
input.en: An extrapolation reading through a map resting on a feature.

conditions.zh: 套索外推要经映射的值可判定。
conditions.en: The lasso extrapolation needs the values through the map decided.

detail.zh: 复用 held_byElimination_rests（未给定界的外推的停息之步）、Law.name、Law.sameFuture_iff_below、prefix_eq_iff、firstFit、firstFit_sound 与 firstFit_found。
detail.en: Reuses held_byElimination_rests (the step at which the extrapolation not given the bound rests), Law.name, Law.sameFuture_iff_below, prefix_eq_iff, firstFit, firstFit_sound and firstFit_found.

output.zh: 有界的前段确定经映射的未来；未给定界的外推的停息之步。
output.en: A bounded prefix fixes the future through the map; the step at which the extrapolation not given the bound rests.

input.zh: 从映射读出的特征在界内学到；依律所建的外推。
input.en: A feature read off the map learned within the bound; the extrapolation built from the law.

conditions.zh: 世界或轨道被列表所持。
conditions.en: The world or the orbit held by a list.

detail.zh: 复用 Law.SameFuture：经映射的未来相同。
detail.en: Reuses Law.SameFuture: the same future through the map.

output.zh: 经映射的未来相同的配置。
output.en: Configurations with the same future through the map.

detail.zh: 复用 Law.fixed_rests：律不变的配置是它自己的轨道。
detail.en: Reuses Law.fixed_rests: a configuration the law leaves unchanged is its own orbit.

conditions.en: The law leaving the configuration unchanged.

detail.zh: 在不变的律下，可学的特征恰是经映射之归并同去者；推广所经的归并就是映射所给的那一个。
detail.en: Under a still law, the learnable features are exactly those going alike across the map's lumping; the lumping generalization goes through is the one the map gives.

detail.zh: 只经阈耦合入的条件只传递是否满足所需；读于外推，阈下的差别只在它在经映射的未来中显现、或从特征中消失之处可学（读法）。
detail.en: A condition coupled in by threshold only passes only whether it meets the need; read for extrapolations, a difference below threshold is learnable only where it shows in the future through the map or vanishes from the feature (a reading).

detail.zh: 其学习一项经映射来读：外推所能学的，不多于经映射的未来所分辨者。
detail.en: Its learning clause read through a map: an extrapolation learns no more than the future through the map tells apart.
